problems: merina-kingdom (af-07-a) uses string counterparts "Sakalava kingdom of Menabe" and "Sakalava kingdom of Boina" instead of the slugs menabe-kingdom and boina-kingdom.
The Merina/Cliopatria 1824 shape has Morondava inside, against the Menabe page's 1834 and 1846 conquest dates (menabe-kingdom).

british-cape-colony (af-07-b) uses the strings Xhosa chiefdoms, Mpondo kingdom, Griqualand West and British Kaffraria as counterparts instead of the slugs xhosa-kingdom, mpondo-kingdom, griqualand-west, british-kaffraria, and has no mirror of the 1877 annexation of Griqualand East.
free-orange-state (af-07-b) dates the end of the 1858 Basutoland contest to 15 October 1858; basutoland uses 1 June 1858 (Free State-Basotho Wars page).
transvaal-colony and orange-river-colony start 31 May 1902 (not 1900 as the af-07-b report suggested) so the 1900-02 occupation recorded in the Boer republic dossiers is not double-counted.
mutapa-empire ends 1885, but the Chioko rising (1897-1902) is entered only in portuguese-mozambique against the counterpart mutapa-empire.
swazi-kingdom ends 1885 with a dissolve (counterpart swaziland); af-07-b swaziland starts 1885 with a found event. The 1881 Pretoria Convention loss is not mirrored in south-african-republic.
zululand (af-07-b) names mtetwa-paramountcy and ndwandwe-kingdom; both now exist, and the Zulu 1816-1819 core overlaps the Mthethwa (1816) and Ndwandwe (1818-19) boxes.

Several capital points are APPROXIMATE stand-ins (Danamombe, Chaimite, Xai-Xai/Chimoio for Gaza, Pedi, Mpondo, Mthethwa, Ndwandwe, Swazi, Lozi, Makololo and Xhosa capitals); Kokstad, Griquatown and King William's Town coordinates are the researcher's own knowledge.
Area checks: the Mutapa shape is about 266k km2 against the infobox 700k (marked dubious; ratio 0.38); Gaza province about 67k against 56k (0.84); Lesotho about 28k against 30,355 (0.92).
portuguese-mozambique may overlap the Portuguese shapes of eu-12 and the af-08 colonial group.
Union of South Africa (1910-1961) is not written here; it belongs with af-08 south-africa.
pedi-empire and gaza-empire carry a rulers list although the schema asks for one only for documented lists; the reviewer may drop it.

Gazetteer gaps leave 10 names unresolved in the validator --resolve output (Sena, British Bechuanaland, British Kaffraria, Conquered Territory, Griqualand East, Griqualand West, Kionga Triangle, Pondoland, Sekhukhuneland, Xesibeland).
